fee_notes: Initial franchise fee varies by location type: up to $25,000 for traditional sit-down locations, up to $20,000 for delivery/carryout locations, up to $7,500 for convenience stores and other non-traditional locations. Fees depend on number and type of locations, development area, and franchisee financial condition. GPI may provide reductions up to the full maximum fee as an incentive for additional development. In GPI's last fiscal year, fees were $25,000 for one full service location, $0–$7,500 for non-traditional locations, and $0–$5,000 for purchasers of existing units from another franchisee. Honorably discharged veterans may receive a $10,000 reduction from the maximum fee for traditional or delivery/carryout locations. Area development fee is normally $3,000 per location, applied to the initial franchise fee in most cases. Fees are non-refundable after GPI completes its initial assistance obligation.
raw_excerpt:
The initial franchise fee for traditional sit-down locations will be up to $25,000, and for delivery/carryout locations will be up to $20,000. The initial franchise fee for convenience stores and other non-traditional locations will be up to $7,500. Your initial franchise fee will depend upon the number and type of locations you plan to develop, the area you propose to develop, and your financial condition.

Initial franchise fees in GPI's last fiscal year, excluding marketing materials purchased from GPI, were $25,000 for one full service location, from $0 to $7,500 for non-traditional locations and from $0 to $5,000 for franchisees who purchased existing units from another franchisee.
